description: A per-scene critique of an explanation_plan, produced BEFORE anything renders. The pipeline's only prior visual review was checkGeneratedImageMatchesNarration, which runs after generation, judges one AI image at a time, and deliberately flags only active contradiction -- it cannot see the plan as a whole and by design says nothing about a scene that is merely weak, generic, static, or a repeat of its neighbour. Those are the defects that actually cost watchability, and they are all visible in the plan, where fixing one costs a revision rather than a re-render. This is the storyboard/animatic review step that hand-animated explainer production runs before committing to animation.

overall_verdict.description: `revise` whenever any scene is judged weak. `ship` means every scene is at least adequate and the episode's visuals earn their screen time.

episode_note.description: One or two sentences on the episode's visual arc as a whole -- repetition across scenes, a dead stretch, a payoff that does not land. Concerns that belong to no single scene.

scene_index.description: The scene being judged, matching the plan's own scene_index.

verdict.description: `weak` means this scene's visual does not earn its seconds and must be revised. `adequate` means it works but is not doing anything special. Reserve `strong` for scenes where the visual genuinely adds something the narration alone does not.

failure_mode.description: none: the scene is fine. generic-visual: the graphic would suit almost any topic. claim-mismatch: the graphic asserts something other than what the line says, including a reversed direction. static: nothing meaningfully changes across the scene's duration. repeats-neighbour: near-identical to the scene before or after, so the frame reads as frozen. unauthored-structure: a relationship primitive with no model_relations, which falls back to a fixed topology unrelated to this episode. overfull-label: text authored longer than its box can render.

note.description: What is actually wrong, in terms of what a viewer would see. Empty for a scene with no problem.

suggested_fix.description: The concrete change to make: which field to alter and to what. Empty for a scene with no problem.
